name: Murgh Tikka (Tandoori Boneless Chicken Breast)
whyItWorks: Lean chunks of boneless chicken breast marinated in yogurt and mild Indian spices, skewered and roasted in the dry heat of the tandoor. It is ultra-lean protein without heavy cream gravies.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for mild seasoning and skip the raw sliced red onion and lemon wedge garnish. Pair with plain basmati rice.
